# [AnophelesModel](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/)

AnophelesModel is an R package to quantify the impact of vector control
interventions according to mosquito species characteristics. It can be
used to parameterize a [dynamical model of the mosquito feeding
cycle](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/17513750701769857)
using data about mosquito bionomics (entomological characteristics) and
biting patterns, as well as human activity and intervention effects. The
different types of data have been extracted from field studies and are
included in the package. The model infers the species-specific impact of
various vector control interventions on the vectorial capacity. The
package can be used to compare the impact of interventions for different
mosquito species and to generate geographic-specific parameterizations
for the entomological and vector control components of more complex
models of malaria transmission dynamics.

Version 2 is a refactoring of version 1 and is not backward compatible
with it: see
[NEWS.md](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/NEWS.md) for the
differences. Version 1 is associated with the following manuscript: M.
Golumbeanu, O. Briët, C. Champagne, J. Lemant, M. Winkel, B. Zogo, M.
Gerhards, M. Sinka, N. Chitnis, M. Penny, E. Pothin, T. Smith.
“**AnophelesModel: An R package to interface mosquito bionomics, human
exposure and intervention effects with models of malaria intervention
impact**”
[2024](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1011609).

The scripts and data used for generating figures 2-4 in the manuscript
are provided in
[extdata](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/extdata) (scripts
`example_fig2.R`, etc.). They use version 1 of the package (release
v1.1.0).

To install the package:
`{r} devtools::install_github("SwissTPH/AnophelesModel")`

To install version 1:
`{r} devtools::install_github("SwissTPH/AnophelesModel@v1.1.0")`

# Package index

## All functions

- [`activity_patterns`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/activity_patterns.md)
  : Human and mosquito behavioural patterns
- [`add_OM_GVI()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/add_OM_GVI.md)
  : Add vector control interventions to an OpenMalaria scenario
- [`AnophelesModel`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/AnophelesModel-package.md)
  [`AnophelesModel-package`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/AnophelesModel-package.md)
  : The main usages of the package
- [`build_model_obj()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/build_model_obj.md)
  : Incorporate vector and host parameters in the entomological model
- [`calculate_combined_impact()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/calculate_combined_impact.md)
  : Calculate impact for a combination of two interventions
- [`calculate_exposure()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/calculate_exposure.md)
  : Calculate indoor and outdoor human exposure to biting
- [`calculate_impact()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/calculate_impact.md)
  : Calculate vectorial capacity reduction for a list of interventions
- [`calculate_impact_timepoint()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/calculate_impact_timepoint.md)
  : Evaluate the entomological model at a single time point
- [`decay_function()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/decay_function.md)
  : Parametric decay functions for intervention effects
- [`define_OM_entomology()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/define_OM_entomology.md)
  : Define the entomology of an OpenMalaria scenario
- [`define_OM_vector_control()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/define_OM_vector_control.md)
  : Define a vector control intervention in an OpenMalaria scenario
- [`def_activity_patterns()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/def_activity_patterns.md)
  : defines the activity patterns of vectors and hosts
- [`def_host_params()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/def_host_params.md)
  : define host-specific entomological parameters
- [`def_vector_params()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/def_vector_params.md)
  : define the vector-specific entomological parameters
- [`deploy_OM_vector_control()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/deploy_OM_vector_control.md)
  : Deploy a vector control intervention in an OpenMalaria scenario
- [`eir_shares()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/eir_shares.md)
  : Share of each mosquito species in the EIR
- [`get_ITN_params()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/get_ITN_params.md)
  : Load ITN efficacy parameters from the built-in database
- [`get_OM_ento_snippet()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/get_OM_ento_snippet.md)
  : Mosquito parameters for an OpenMalaria scenario
- [`get_OM_GVI_snippet()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/get_OM_GVI_snippet.md)
  : Vector control intervention for an OpenMalaria scenario
- [`get_OM_xml()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/get_OM_xml.md)
  [`print(`*`<om_xml>`*`)`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/get_OM_xml.md)
  : OpenMalaria XML snippets, as text
- [`host_ent_param`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/host_ent_param.md)
  : Host-specific estimated parameters for the entomological model of
  malaria transmission
- [`ITN_parameterisations_Champagne2025`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/ITN_parameterisations_Champagne2025.md)
  : ITN efficacy parameterisations from experimental hut trials
- [`list_activity()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/list_activity.md)
  : Extract activity patterns of humans or mosquitoes
- [`list_all_species()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/list_all_species.md)
  : List the taxa with entomological parameters in the package database
- [`list_ITN_params()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/list_ITN_params.md)
  : List available ITN parameterisations
- [`om_campaigns()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/om_campaigns.md)
  : Schedule of vector control campaigns
- [`om_continuous()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/om_continuous.md)
  : Continuous deployment of a vector control intervention
- [`om_ento_values()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/om_ento_values.md)
  : Values of the species contribution placeholders of an OpenMalaria
  entomology
- [`om_scenario_values()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/om_scenario_values.md)
  : Fill the vector control placeholders of a scenario table
- [`om_vector_control()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/om_vector_control.md)
  : Specify a vector control intervention for OpenMalaria
- [`plot_impact()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/plot_impact.md)
  : Plot the reduction in vectorial capacity against coverage
- [`read_bionomics_table()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/read_bionomics_table.md)
  : Read a vector bionomics table from a CSV file
- [`run_interventions()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/run_interventions.md)
  : Run the entomological model across multiple parameter sets
- [`vec_ent_param`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesModel/reference/vec_ent_param.md)
  : Vector-specific estimated entomological parameters
